interruption.source: Computer Use reported a physical Escape-key interruption during the source-overwrite dialog check.
interruption.response: Stopped all Computer Use and Playwright window/IPC operations. No subsequent process or clipboard cleanup. Parent explicitly authorized only file/terminal evidence and source checks.

scope: Actual development Electron runtime using current production main/preload/renderer, actual local TLS CLI backend, actual SQLite replay and registered MCP WAV. Not a packaged installer acceptance.

bootstrapAdaptations: Set userData/sessionData/logs/crashDumps/temp and disk cache to this D-drive validation directory before production imports; production userData then selects the supplied D-drive app root.
Resolve existing workspace dependencies via NODE_PATH plus Module._initPaths; use existing ui/desktop/src as development resourcesPath for required Windows shims.
Suppress only Windows default lumina:// application registration in validation bootstrap; production lumina-media protocol and native IPC are unchanged.
ENABLE_PLAYWRIGHT=true skips React DevTools automatic installation via the single production startup adjustment.

r2: validation lookup additionally needed existing desktop workspace SDK link

notes: Empty app configuration; no model inference/download performed
Actual production main/preload/renderer; native local TLS backend started
Existing workspace dependencies and development resources reused; no installer claim

completedNativeChecks: Restored the actual persisted session through the production resume route, expanded its real MCP tool output and registered media card.
Native audio control decoded 2.4-second WAV with readyState 4, no autoplay, no decoder error.
Keyboard controls performed play, pause and seek. The actual opaque protocol response was 206 with matching length, ETag and Content-Range.
Real Copy path action wrote a registered source path to the OS clipboard; file bytes and SHA matched the registered result.
Real native Save As dialog wrote saved-native.wav under the validation directory; complete bytes/SHA matched and source remained unchanged at that check.
A second real Save As dialog was cancelled; UI reported cancelled and source remained unchanged at that check.
Real Show in folder action opened Explorer and visibly selected the registered WAV. Only this newly created Explorer window was closed.

openFileBoundary.observationSource: Subsequent Computer Use screenshot showed the Windows existing-application chooser for .wav overlaying the save dialog. This observation occurred after native-checks-progress.json was saved.
openFileBoundary.interpretation: OS open handoff is observed; shell acceptance does not prove external playback or selection of an application.

unverifiedNativeChecks: Source-overwrite rejection through the actual native dialog; no overwrite was submitted.
Cross-window and subframe rejection through actual Electron IPC/protocol.
Session-switch/window-close cancellation, opaque mapping revocation and guard release in the actual desktop runtime.
External player decoding after OS application selection.
Packaged Electron installer/deployment, remote backend and TLS/proxy variants.

sceneAtStopNotRechecked.managedBackend: Still owned by the validation Electron app at the stop; do not concurrently start another process against the same app database.
sceneAtStopNotRechecked.nativeDialog: Save As open; filename field last observed empty; no pending overwrite was submitted.
sceneAtStopNotRechecked.clipboard: Original clipboard formats were retained in main-process globalThis.mediaQaClipboard. They were not restored after the stop.
sceneAtStopNotRechecked.workingDirectoryObservation: The initial resume deep-link backend startup logged the Windows home directory; restored session UI showed D:/Project/goose. Managed app/cache/log/temp paths remained on D/E.
